csv_project_name: Engineering Svc for South Mooney Bridge
csv_scope_of_work: The Village of Jemez Springs (the "Village") is soliciting sealed proposals from qualified engineering firms to provide professional engineering services for the planning, design, and environmental clearance of the South Mooney Bridge replacement. The project involves the replacement of a 50' single-lane pony truss bridge on Mooney Blvd over the Jemez River. The project will include long range planning, prioritization and programming, study scoping and conceptual design, and preliminary and final design for the South Mooney Bridge.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
csv_comments: ' *** Time Sensitive *** - Project Number: 2026-02- Project Funding: NMDOT- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/22/2026 05:00 PM MDT - Multiple contracts may be awarded
title: Engineering Services for South Mooney Bridge
short_description: Engineering services for planning and design of a replacement single-lane bridge in Jemez Springs.
project_scope: Replacement of the existing 50 ft single-lane pony truss South Mooney Bridge on Mooney Blvd over the Jemez River, including long-range planning, prioritization and programming, study scoping, conceptual design, and preliminary and final design, as well as environmental clearance.
services: Professional engineering services for planning, design, and environmental clearance; disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge project with structural engineering scope, directly relevant to sbp's bridge expertise.
- New replacement bridge rather than pure maintenance, which is more relevant for sbp.
- Includes planning and design services from concept through final design, offering early strategic entry.
- Existing bridge span is about 50 ft, so the project is relatively small and not a long-span or highly complex signature structure.
- Road bridge category fits sbp interests, but modest scale limits priority.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost stated as $500.0K.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Available fee-related basis: bridge replacement project with planning, environmental clearance, conceptual, preliminary, and final design for a 50 ft road bridge with multidisciplinary engineering input.
references_qualifications: Qualified engineering firms are requested. Specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided source excerpt.

notes: Project number 2026-02; funding noted as NMDOT. Questions deadline: 06/22/2026 05:00 PM MDT. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Source indicates solicitation documents available online.
